description: A man in a dark brown coat with his back and profile to the viewer stands on a stone balcony with an iron railing. He rests one hand on a book on a red cushion held by a younger man in brown. Behind them, several men in dark clothing and wide-brimmed hats stand in a dense crowd below and to the left, with columns, a classical building and two small flags in the background. The image fills the frame edge to edge.
